entities.name: Algli
entities.description: An elderly former tanner who lost her family to ghouls and joined a cult trying to summon the Buried Lord, then allies with Liesa.

entities.name: Liesa
aliases: archangel who once lead the Flight of Dusk
entities.description: An archangel who once led the Flight of Dusk, was killed by Avacyn, and returns when Algli's ritual calls her; she seeks balance and parley.

entities.name: The Buried Lord
entities.description: A deathless demon summoned by the cult who is hungry rather than protective and who once parleyed with Liesa.

entities.name: Olutio
entities.description: The gruff leader of the cult and researcher, whose daughter was reanimated by a ghoulcaller; he is killed by the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Sruta
entities.description: A scornful cultist with crafts and tools who leaves the failed ritual and is eaten by the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel who slew Liesa; churches were raised in her name.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: The archangel who survives with her flight, the last of Liesa's sisters.

entities.name: Flight of Herons
entities.description: The surviving flight of angels led by Sigarda.

entities.name: Flight of Dusk
entities.description: The small flight of angels once led by Liesa.

entities.name: The Buried Lord's cult
entities.description: A dwindling group of worshippers led by Olutio who try to summon the Buried Lord to keep the dead at rest.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The catastrophe that ruined Innistrad, felling Gavony and the angels.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where ghouls, werewolves and ghoulcallers overrun the moors.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A region whose fall Algli recounts.

events.summary: Algli's husband and sons die in a ghoul attack on the family tannery, and she survives by setting the tannery aflame.
events.quote: Her husband and her youngest son threw themselves between her and the ghouls, and she set the tannery aflame.

events.summary: A ghoulcaller raises Algli's dead family; she meets Olutio and together they slay him, and Olutio first speaks to her of the Buried Lord.
events.quote: Standing over their fresh graves, Olutio first spoke to her of the Buried Lord.

events.summary: The three cultists perform the last ritual in the clearing with a goat, but nothing seems to happen.
events.quote: A goat, hooves and horns, in the image of a demon.

events.summary: Sruta calls Olutio and Algli fools and leaves, and Olutio follows, leaving Algli alone with her despair.
events.quote: "You were always a fool, Olutio," she said.

events.summary: Algli finds a wounded angel behind her who says she is compelled to answer the call and that the Buried Lord is hungry.
events.quote: "But the Buried Lord has never been one to protect. He is here, and he is hungry."

events.summary: Algli bandages Liesa's wound and tells her about the Travails and the fall of the angels.
events.quote: Algli bandaged the angel's ribs firmly

events.summary: Liesa introduces herself as an archangel who once led the Flight of Dusk and asks Algli to help her rebury the Buried Lord.
events.quote: "I am Liesa, archangel who once lead the Flight of Dusk.

events.summary: Liesa and Algli find Olutio's gutted body.
events.quote: They found the gutted remains of Olutio first

events.summary: The Buried Lord devours Sruta in front of them and greets Liesa as an old friend.
events.quote: On the last word his teeth sunk into Sruta, snuffing her screams with a gruesome tear.

events.summary: The Buried Lord offers Liesa an alliance if she hands over Algli, and she refuses.
events.quote: "Give me the third, and she will be my last."

events.summary: Liesa drives her spear into the Buried Lord's spine and he vanishes, but then he erupts from the ground and seizes Algli.
events.quote: Liesa drove the spear deep into the demon's spine.

events.summary: Algli chants the old rites and feeds the Buried Lord's strength; Liesa orders her to fall silent.
events.quote: As the cultist chanted, the darkness soaked into the demon.

events.summary: Algli offers her life and thrusts her torch into the Buried Lord's mouth, and Liesa channels the fire and hope through her spear to behead him.
events.quote: With both hands, Algli thrust her torch into the roof of the Buried Lord's gaping maw.

events.summary: Liesa beheads the Buried Lord, but his body does not crumble, and she feels they are still bound.
events.quote: Liesa yanked her spear free with a twist

events.summary: Algli offers to forge the Buried Lord's remains into Liesa's armor and to serve her; Liesa asks for an alliance instead and Algli swears to be her ally.
events.quote: "As I breathe and hope, my lady Liesa.

relations.note: She swears to be Liesa's ally.
relations.quote: You have me as your ally.
the man Algli had described as their sect's leader
slain by Avacyn, she had drifted on the aether for centuries
archangel who once lead the Flight of Dusk
all but the archangel Sigarda and her flight
Their deaths are on the claws of the Buried Lord.
swallowing the last bloody traces of his summoner
